sources.title: Helena AI: eight AI and design resources
sources.summary: Category: design-resource-roundup. Exact public X post resolved; eight outbound links extracted from the post, excluding profile links and replies. Expanded X link targets were visited over HTTPS. Resource counts and pricing claims in the post are not independently guaranteed.

links.title: MotionSites Studio
links.summary: Category: ai-website-builder. Public page offers AI customization of existing designs, business copy, images and videos.
links.license: Proprietary; no separate redistribution license found on the Studio page. Related MotionSites terms permit building projects but prohibit republishing its prompt/source library.

links.title: MotionSites
links.summary: Category: ai-design-prompts. Website prompt, motion-design and background library with free previews and paid offerings.
links.license: Custom terms permit using and modifying prompts/source in projects; prohibit redistributing prompt text or source itself, republishing the library and bulk scraping. Metadata only for this offline library.

links.title: Land-book
links.summary: Category: landing-page-inspiration. Post describes landing-page inspiration; destination visit returned HTTP 403, so its content and reuse terms could not be verified.
links.license: Unknown; inaccessible destination. No permission to copy assets established.

links.title: Recent
links.summary: Category: design-inspiration. Public gallery organizes web, interface, branding, motion, illustration, poster and print references.
links.license: No explicit asset redistribution license found on the public landing page. Gallery availability is not permission to copy third-party work.

links.title: Landdding
links.summary: Category: landing-page-inspiration. Community-submitted website gallery with daily and weekly views, categories and templates.
links.license: Terms reserve site-content intellectual property to Landdding or third parties and limit content use to personal, non-commercial needs. No offline asset redistribution permission established.

links.title: Font In Logo
links.summary: Category: typography-reference. Catalog identifies fonts used in famous brand logos; visit redirects to www.fontinlogo.com.
links.license: No explicit font, logo or screenshot redistribution license found on the landing page. Font and trademark rights require separate verification.

links.title: Godly / Recent
links.summary: Category: design-inspiration. This exact destination currently redirects to https://recent.design/?ref=godly, rather than serving a separate gallery.
links.license: No explicit redistribution license found on the redirected gallery. Metadata only; third-party designs are not licensed by public visibility.

links.title: 60fps
links.summary: Category: interaction-inspiration. Curated mobile and web UI/UX animation references with shots, motion breakdowns and an MCP offering.
links.license: Proprietary terms explicitly prohibit bulk copying, mirroring, caching, rehosting, standalone reference libraries and redistribution through another product/API. Do not import its library.

sources.title: eigen: twenty motion-production repositories
sources.summary: Category: motion-toolchain. Exact public X post resolved and all twenty directly linked repositories visited. The post calls them open-source skills, but the destinations are software projects, not verified Opus-specific skill packages. Remotion has a custom license, so the blanket open-source characterization is inaccurate. License evidence was inspected without downloading repository code, media or articles.

links.title: Remotion
links.summary: Category: programmatic-video. React-based video/image creation and rendering toolkit.
links.license: Custom Remotion License, not blanket MIT/open-source permission. Free use is limited to eligible entities including individuals and for-profit organizations with up to three employees; other organizations require a company license. Offline redistribution not established.

links.title: HyperFrames
links.summary: Category: programmatic-video. Agent-oriented HTML-to-video rendering project.
links.license: Apache-2.0 verified in root LICENSE; redistribution requires license retention and applicable notice/change obligations. Check separately licensed dependencies/assets before copying.

links.title: Anime.js
links.summary: Category: animation-engine. JavaScript animation engine for timelines and visual choreography.
links.license: MIT verified in LICENSE.md; retain copyright and permission notice with copied software. Separate assets/dependencies require their own review.

links.title: React Spring
links.summary: Category: spring-animation. Spring-physics animation library for React.
links.license: MIT verified in LICENSE on the next branch; retain copyright and permission notice.

links.title: PixiJS
links.summary: Category: graphics-2d. GPU-accelerated JavaScript 2D rendering library.
links.license: MIT verified in root LICENSE on dev; retain copyright and permission notice. Demo artwork is not automatically covered.

links.title: p5.js
links.summary: Category: creative-coding. Browser creative-coding platform for generative visuals and interactive sketches.
links.license: LGPL-2.1 license text verified in license.txt. Redistribution must meet applicable LGPL conditions; not interchangeable with MIT. Check example/media licenses independently.

links.title: Paper.js
links.summary: Category: vector-graphics. Canvas-based vector graphics scripting with paths and geometric operations.
links.license: MIT verified in LICENSE.txt despite GitHub's generic License badge; retain copyright and permission notice.

links.title: Matter.js
links.summary: Category: physics-2d. Web-oriented 2D rigid-body physics engine.
links.license: MIT verified in LICENSE; retain copyright and permission notice.

links.title: Three.js
links.summary: Category: graphics-3d. JavaScript 3D scene and rendering library.
links.license: MIT verified in LICENSE on dev; retain copyright and permission notice. Models, textures and examples need separate asset-license review.

links.title: Rapier
links.summary: Category: physics-3d. Performance-oriented 2D and 3D physics engines.
links.license: Apache-2.0 verified in LICENSE; retain license and applicable notices and document modifications.

links.title: OGL
links.summary: Category: webgl-shaders. Minimal WebGL library for custom graphics and shaders.
links.license: Unlicense public-domain dedication and unrestricted-use text verified in repository README. The README's linked master/LICENSE returned 404; use the actually visible README evidence, not that broken file.

links.title: tsParticles
links.summary: Category: particle-animation. Configurable particles, confetti, fireworks and animated backgrounds with framework integrations.
links.license: MIT verified in root LICENSE; retain copyright and permission notice. Review external preset/demo media separately.

links.title: glTF Transform
links.summary: Category: asset-optimization. JavaScript/TypeScript SDK for editing and optimizing glTF 2.0 assets.
links.license: MIT verified in LICENSE.md; retain copyright and permission notice. This licenses the tool, not arbitrary 3D assets processed by it.

links.title: GL Transitions
links.summary: Category: shader-transitions. Open collection of GPU shader transition effects.
links.license: MIT verified in root LICENSE; retain copyright and permission notice and inspect individual contributions/assets for additional notices.

links.title: OBS Studio
links.summary: Category: screen-capture. Desktop software for screen recording and live streaming.
links.license: GPL-2.0 COPYING verified; redistribution has copyleft/source obligations. The license document includes later-version wording; individual file headers/build dependencies determine exact scope.

links.title: Chatterbox
links.summary: Category: text-to-speech. Open text-to-speech project for generated voice output.
links.license: MIT verified in root LICENSE; retain copyright and permission notice. Independently verify model-weight, dependency and voice-input rights before reuse.

links.title: Tone.js
links.summary: Category: browser-audio. Web Audio framework for interactive music, synthesizers and audio scheduling.
links.license: MIT verified in LICENSE.md on dev; retain copyright and permission notice. Audio samples remain independently licensed.

links.title: faster-whisper
links.summary: Category: speech-transcription. CTranslate2-based implementation of Whisper transcription.
links.license: MIT verified in root LICENSE; retain copyright and permission notice. Model weights and other dependencies require separate verification.

links.title: OpenCut
links.summary: Category: video-editing. Open-source CapCut alternative for timeline-based video editing.
links.license: MIT grant verified in root LICENSE; retain copyright and permission notice. Imported user media is not licensed by the editor.

links.title: FFmpeg
links.summary: Category: media-encoding. Multimedia processing, encoding and delivery toolkit; repository mirrors the upstream Git project.
links.license: LICENSE.md states default combined scope LGPL-2.1-or-later; optional GPL components and version-3 dependencies change obligations, and nonfree configurations can be unredistributable. Evaluate the exact build before distribution.
